_what: Where build_dashboard.py copies the generated dashboard after writing it. Editable WITHOUT touching the script body; override the file itself with the PGM3_DASHBOARD_TARGETS environment variable.
_a_silent_copy_failure_is_the_danger: A stale dashboard that looks current is exactly the failure this project keeps meeting. So a copy that cannot be made is reported as FAILED and the script exits non-zero. It is never skipped quietly.
_what_cannot_be_detected: That the bytes reached Google's servers. This checks the file was written to the synced folder and reads back with a matching md5. Whether the Drive client then UPLOADS it is outside the filesystem and outside this script. The page carries its own generation timestamp, so a stale copy is visible on the page itself.
